name: crook
description: Crook, a terminal whose unit of work is an agent: the plugin that connects Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot CLI to it.

plugins.name: crook
plugins.description: Reports what Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot CLI is doing to the Crook tab it runs in, lets the person there Allow once or Deny a Claude Code Bash command from a card in the Crook window, and carries Crook's skill. Does nothing in any other terminal.
